intro: Terra Colinas is a Bee Cave subdivision of about 200 production homes from the 2010s, near Hamilton Pool Road. CleanzATX cleans the glass and keeps stucco and limestone looking fresh.

sections.h2: What Terra Colinas homes are like
paragraphs: Terra Colinas is a 2010s subdivision of roughly 200 homes in Bee Cave, built by production builders and priced from about $500,000 to $800,000. Sizes run from 1,800 up to 5,800 square feet, so you can find a modest family home and a very large one on the same road. The Terra Colinas HOA oversees the community and it is not gated. Homes sit on regular suburban lots, with fenced backyards and two car garages.
Exteriors lean on stucco and stone fronts. Production homes share window layouts from one house to the next, which is why we can estimate a quote quickly.

sections.h2: What Terra Colinas windows deal with
paragraphs: Homes of this age have tight landscaping beds right against the walls, and the sprinklers in them hit the glass. That is the usual source of the white spots on lower windows. Hamilton Pool Road and the building around Bee Cave bring dust, and the cedar and oak seasons leave their own layers. Backyard trees produce webs and small leaf litter around sliding doors.
Our pure water rinse does not leave soap behind, so the glass stays cleaner for longer than a bucket wash. Tracks and screens are $5 each, and the stucco gets a soft wash with no pressure.

The streets are open and easy to work. Fenced yards matter: we ask you to unlatch gates or tell us the combination, and we close them as we found them. Because many homes here share a plan, neighbors who book together tend to get matching prices. Many families here do exterior and interior, and some add a driveway clean with a surface cleaner.
Consider a 2,600 square foot house. Exterior windows come to about $260, and on site that is around two to two and three quarter hours. The inside at $15 a window brings it to about $390.

faq.q: Do you need to come into my backyard?
faq.a: Usually yes, for back windows. We ask you to unlatch gates, or we get the code by text, and we close them when finished.

faq.q: What causes the white spots on lower windows?
faq.a: Sprinkler water in landscape beds. It dries into mineral spots. We remove them for $10 per pane.

faq.q: Will you quote before you come?
